audio_analysis_modules.loading.load_and_preprocess(file_path, track_num, manual_bpm_override=None)[source]

Loads audio, trims leading/trailing silence, calculates tempo (using Median IBI fallback or manual override), and returns basic features.

Parameters:

  • file_path (str) – Path to the audio file.

  • track_num (int) – Identifier for the track (e.g., 1 or 2).

  • manual_bpm_override (float, optional) – If provided, overrides detected BPM.

Returns:

A dictionary containing processed audio (‘y_processed’),

original audio (‘y_original’), sample rate (‘sr’), beats per minute (‘bpm’), detected bpm (‘bpm_detected’), trim offset (‘trim_offset_sec’), processed duration (‘duration_processed’), hop length (‘hop_length’), and original file path (‘file_path’). Returns None on failure.

Return type:

dict or None
